name: task-create-base-branch-default
title: task.py create records the current branch as base_branch
description: task.py create writes base_branch = current branch unconditionally (task_store.py:325). Creating a task from a feature branch records a base_branch that is deleted after the PR merges, leaving a dangling reference that no command validates. sd-create-pr never reads the field -- it resolves the PR base from SD_AI_COMMAND_PACK_CREATE_PR_BASE, the GitHub default branch, or origin/HEAD -- so for a standalone task the cost is a stale record plus a silently weakened sd-finish-work guard, not a mis-targeted PR; inside a parent/child tree the review preflight additionally rejects a child base_branch that does not match its parent. Decide between defaulting to the repository default branch, adding an explicit --base-branch flag, or documenting the correction step.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Five confirmed occurrences. 2026-08-06: 08-06-session-first-skill-review and 08-06-ship-gate-ordering-docs held the deleted branch task/07-28-enhance-skills-workflow; 08-06-prism-rules-lane-divergence and 08-06-sd-review-local-rebuttal-gap were created wrong from a feature branch and corrected immediately. 2026-08-07: 08-07-review-py-local-fork was created wrong, was not caught by any deterministic check, reached PR #166 still holding the feature branch, and was corrected in 9f16829 only after a paid Copilot round. A sweep on 2026-08-07 found all 25 active records naming main, so nothing dead is currently stored here. Root cause at task_store.py:296-298 and :325 -- the `or "main"` fallback covers only detached HEAD, never the ordinary case. .trellis/scripts/common/task_store.py is tracked in .trellis/.template-hashes.json, so a code fix is upstream work needing its own approval; only .trellis/spec/ is editable locally. Independent of 08-06-task-json-trailing-newline -- same file tree, unrelated cause. Sequencing: this task writes .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md at order 50 in the P2 band; write-set membership and the band-aware landing sequence are documented in .trellis/tasks/08-08-trellis-backlog-hygiene/record.md.
